steps: partition evidence by domain mode, jurisdiction/scope, authority class, version, and applicable time
reject false conflicts caused by different scopes or historical versions
within the same material scope, prefer controlling or explicitly authoritative primary sources only when the authority relationship is resolved
do not use publication recency alone to override controlling legal authority, current clinical guidance, or an explicit standard version
when co-primary or co-official sources materially disagree and neither controls, preserve CONFLICT
when source identity, version, applicability, or temporal scope is unresolved, return MODE_UNRESOLVED
never synthesize conflicting authorities into an invented compromise rule

high_stakes_guards.LEGAL: unresolved conflict cannot support a binding legal claim
high_stakes_guards.MEDICAL: unresolved conflict cannot be silently converted into normative patient-specific guidance
high_stakes_guards.SECURITY: conflicting vulnerability status must preserve product/version scope
